title: GoatHornDeath
description: A simple administrative datapack that allows server owners to place a "curse" on specific players. Once cursed, a player will instantly die whenever they use a goat horn.
body:
# GoatHornDeath Tagged

GoatHornDeath Tagged is a lightweight Minecraft datapack that allows server owners and administrators to place a goat horn curse on specific players.

When a player with the `hornkill` tag uses a goat horn, they are instantly killed. Players without the tag can use goat horns normally, making this a useful tool for events, pranks, roleplay servers, and dealing with goat horn spammers.

## Features

* Tag specific players with a goat horn curse.
* Instant death when a cursed player uses a goat horn.
* Unaffected gameplay for all other players.
* Multiplayer friendly.
* Lightweight and easy to use.
* No mods required.

## Commands

### Add the curse

```mcfunction
/tag <player> add hornkill
```

### Remove the curse

```mcfunction
/tag <player> remove hornkill
```

## Example

To curse a player named Steve:

```mcfunction
/tag Steve add hornkill
```

To remove the curse:

```mcfunction
/tag Steve remove hornkill
```

## Use Cases

* Punishing goat horn spammers.
* Server events and mini-games.
* Roleplay mechanics.
* Friendly pranks between players.
* Custom server challenges.

## Compatibility

* Minecraft Java Edition
* Datapack installation required
* Multiplayer and singleplayer supported
